name: @quizdock/quiz-store-publish
description: Validates QuizDock bundles and publishes them with an index: the CLI, and the GitHub Action that wraps it.

scripts.build: esbuild src/action.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/action.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
